name: multi-arch-images
title: Multi-arch Docker images: linux/amd64 + linux/arm64 via native runners
description: Fix the R6 kill-list defect: the arm64 wait-signal was self-referential (arm users cannot pull an image that does not exist, so the signal could never arrive) and its cost premise was stale (free arm64 hosted runners for public repos since 2025-01; CGO=0 cross-compile needs no QEMU). Deliverables: Dockerfile cross-compile (FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM + TARGETARCH, one build path unchanged for humans), workflow matrix of two NATIVE jobs (ubuntu-latest/amd64 + ubuntu-24.04-arm/arm64) each running scripts/docker-smoke.sh unchanged (extraction payoff), push-by-digest then tag-in-merge-job so nothing pullable exists before smoke passes, first multi-arch tag v0.4.1 (v0.4.0 stays amd64-only forever — tags supersede, never rewrite)
creator: killbus
